title: xo stats — rolling project metrics
description: Rolling 7d/30d activity stats plus per-session, per-runtime, and per-day breakdowns. Updated by the watcher from normalized runtime events and never hand-edited. Schema 2 adds the optional `by_day` block; schema 1 readers continue to work because `by_day` is optional and BFF helpers treat absence as zero-filled. The document also carries two underscore-prefixed PRIVATE accumulators the sink persists in-band (`_session_totals`, `_by_day_totals`) so a restart recovers its state without a sidecar; they are declared here because the document is `additionalProperties: false` and the sink has always written them. They are stripped by the BFF route allowlist and are not part of any wire shape. Cost is representable but never computed: see `definitions.cost_usd`.

by_day.description: Per-UTC-day rollup, capped to ~35 entries (30d analytics window + 5d buffer). Keys are YYYY-MM-DD. Introduced in schema 2.

_session_totals.description: PRIVATE durable accumulator, keyed by native session id. The sink rebuilds the public `by_session` view from it on every tick, so it must survive a restart — it lives in this file rather than a sidecar. Written by services/cowork_agent/visualizer/sinks/stats.py; stripped before any BFF response. Not a wire field: readers outside the sink must use `by_session`.

_by_day_totals.description: PRIVATE durable accumulator for `by_day`, keyed YYYY-MM-DD. Same shape as the public view (the sink writes the same object under both keys today) and kept for the same restart-recovery reason as `_session_totals`. Stripped before any BFF response.

cost_usd.description: Money attributable to this bucket, in USD. Absent or `null` means UNKNOWN — there is no pricing table in this repo (the real one lives in the out-of-tree Argus daemon and is already stale), so nothing computes this today. syncplan §13 decision O6: cost stays null, and a confident `0.0` is never emitted. `exclusiveMinimum: 0` makes that structural rather than advisory — writing 0.0 as a stand-in for `unknown` is a schema violation, because a bucket that consumed tokens did not cost nothing. Declared at every level so cost is representable the day a pricing table exists; until then a reader MUST render unknown, not $0.00.

by_model.description: Map of model id → window-scoped sub-stats.

by_tool.description: Map of tool name → call count over this window. Populated from per-session tool tallies. Introduced in schema 2 (Phase 2 / Stage 2).

tools.description: Per-session tool tally. Map of tool name → call count. Introduced in schema 2.

by_model.description: Per-session token split by model. Map of model id → {input, output}. Introduced in schema 2.

session_totals_private.description: One entry of `_session_totals`. The sink's own working state — a superset of `session_stats` carrying the first/last timestamps it needs to recompute `duration_ms` and the rolling windows. `required` lists only the keys every revision of the sink has seeded, so a document written before `tools` / `by_model_tokens` existed still validates.

runtime.description: Adapter name that owns the session; empty string until the first event names one.

toolResults.description: NO PRODUCER. The sink seeds this to 0 and never increments it — no branch in services/cowork_agent/visualizer/sinks/stats.py handles a tool result — so a non-zero value cannot occur today. Optional rather than required precisely so it stays droppable: a permanently-zero counter must not read as a measurement.

errors.description: NO PRODUCER — same as `toolResults`. Nothing in ingest/events.py carries an error, so this is seeded to 0 and never incremented.

by_model.description: Map of model id → {input, output, count} for this day.

latency.description: Per-day user→assistant response latency stats in ms. Phase 2 / Stage 4. p95_sample is a bounded reservoir (up to 100 items) used to approximate the p95 at read time.
